## Triage verdict — live, implementation path scoped

**Verified 2026-11-05 at current main** (`1cf701651abdbdfbbd016fc64fdf045999b26e52`): issue #5345 is OPEN, has no hard-stop labels, and `gh pr list --state all --search 5345` found no implementation PR. The feature is not already handled.

The implementation path is already settled in closed design issue #4975: a shared server-side transfer module; source-side user authorization; source server identity for the outbound blob push; destination write-policy check; complete blob before name registration; no-overwrite by default, explicit archived replacement, idempotent retry, and destination origin/first-write metadata. The CLI and REPL are this slice; keep bytes off `/id-world/1` and out of the browser.

**Routing / ordering:** queued implementation follow-up as task 9836 (`repo-health:v1:fix:developing-today/code:issue:5345`). Web adapter issue #5346 is OPEN and explicitly depends on #5345; do not implement its transport independently. Parent #1794 remains OPEN until both surfaces and transfer verification are complete.

## Triage verdict — real and current; implementation has not landed

**Verdict: real-and-current.** This issue is the transport + CLI/REPL slice of #1794, and its design is settled (design issue #4975 closed 2026-11-04 with the "single-file copy through the source server" decision). No implementation exists yet.

Fresh verification at `origin/main` `d222177982` (2026-11-08T19:2xZ):

- **No transfer module.** `pkgs/id/src/fileops.rs` covers local `put`/`rename`/`copy`/`delete` only; there is no server-side transfer module (lookup → authorize → blob push → destination registration → receipt) as the #4975 decision specifies.
- **No send command.** `pkgs/id/src/commands/` has no `send`/`transfer` module, and `pkgs/id/src/cli.rs` has no send subcommand. The REPL likewise has no send verb.
- **No PR.** `gh pr list --state all --search 5345` returns nothing; no merged PR or commit references this issue.
- **Substrate is present and unchanged:** `BLOBS_ALPN` is registered in `pkgs/id/src/local.rs` and used by `commands/put.rs` and `commands/repl.rs`; `/iroh-meta/3` is in `pkgs/id/src/protocol.rs`. So the design's reuse plan is still accurate.
- **Dependencies:** parent #1794 OPEN; sibling web adapter #5346 depends on this slice; #4973/#5191 (listing metadata contract) already merged, so the `origin`/`created` requirement can be implemented as written.
- No hard-stop labels (`held`, `user/owned`, `do-not-merge`, `do-not-auto-edit`).

**Disposition:** returning to the queue as a fix packet scoped to the issue's remaining scope (transport module + CLI/REPL command + two-node test/probe). No implementation was started in this triage task.
